spirits.name: A Revolution without Consent
spirits.description: The presidency claims a mandate to reorganize society while parties remain dissolved and the largest popular movement is excluded.
spirits.remedy: Constitutional restoration removes this spirit. A corporatist settlement replaces it with its own benefits and liabilities.

spirits.name: The Cordobazo Aftermath
spirits.description: Worker and student mobilization has broken the promise of social peace. Disputes at the industrial centers continue to disrupt production.
spirits.remedy: National labor settlement or a completed party labor compact removes it. Repression replaces it with a different burden.

spirits.name: The Stop-Go Economy
spirits.description: Imported capital goods, contested incomes policy and uneven foreign exchange earnings make sustained industrial expansion difficult.
spirits.remedy: A funded stabilization programme replaces this problem. This does not reset native inflation or public debt.

spirits.name: Universities after Intervention
spirits.description: Intervention and the departure of researchers have damaged an established scientific community. Argentina retains considerable technical capacity.
spirits.remedy: University autonomy, technical restoration or a party science programme removes it. No workforce-size penalty.

spirits.name: Competing Service Commands
spirits.description: The services remain political arbiters as well as military institutions. Rival chains of influence complicate common doctrine and budgets.
spirits.remedy: Joint staff reform removes the operational penalty; civilian control separately settles political authority.

spirits.name: A Republic of Uneven Corridors
spirits.description: Industrial concentration in the littoral contrasts with distant northern and southern communities and expensive transport connections.
spirits.remedy: Funded north-south transport and provincial services remove this burden.

conditional_spirits.name: Order under Wage Restraint
conditional_spirits.description: The government holds down nominal demands through administrative discipline, leaving industrial opposition unresolved.
conditional_spirits.remedy: A later constitutional labor settlement replaces it.

conditional_spirits.name: A Foreign-Currency Debt Crisis
conditional_spirits.description: External borrowing and refinancing exposure have become a fiscal emergency. Import compression and costly credit now reinforce the contraction.
conditional_spirits.activation: Native debt ratio above 75% and a recorded external-finance shock, never automatic on 1 January 1970.
conditional_spirits.remedy: Restructuring or a funded adjustment programme replaces the spirit; debt principal remains in the MD economy.

conditional_spirits.name: Austerity and Adjustment
conditional_spirits.description: Credit discipline improves refinancing prospects while unemployment fears and public cuts weaken support for the government.
conditional_spirits.remedy: Expires after 730 days; no automatic repayment of debt.

conditional_spirits.name: South Atlantic Mobilization
conditional_spirits.description: An expeditionary commitment draws on limited trained personnel, spare parts and maritime supply.
conditional_spirits.activation: Chosen mobilization while at war with the United Kingdom.
conditional_spirits.remedy: Removed when the war ends. Standing peacetime agreements suspend during the war.

conditional_spirits.name: The Cost of Defeat
conditional_spirits.description: A failed South Atlantic campaign leaves the armed forces discredited and families demanding an account of the losses.
conditional_spirits.activation: Peace after actual defeat in the South Atlantic campaign.
conditional_spirits.remedy: Civilian inquiry and veterans settlement remove it; a propaganda focus cannot declare a victory.

conditional_spirits.name: Barracks Resistance
conditional_spirits.description: Civilian investigations and budget control provoke resistance inside parts of the officer corps.
conditional_spirits.activation: Accountability option after documented repression, 365 days.
conditional_spirits.remedy: Expires after 365 days or is replaced by a negotiated constitutional settlement.

integration.sync: Proposed: preserve earned values per exact party and leader. Refresh on government/leader changes, weekly tick and load. Only the current owner contributes its programme spirit and weekly costs; earned buildings, cash, XP, research and ratified contracts never replay.
integration.policy: National economic/institutional choices remain earned across governments. A government change is not a free policy reset. Programme-level exclusions remain saved and visible.
integration.agreements: One Argentine focus per offer; recipient Accept/Decline decisions. Both parties receive complete prospective native effects in locked focus tooltips. A signed contract has no expiry. Active state and weekly transfers suspend and restore in both countries on war, embargo, any mirrored sanction or inactive required parent. No setup, buildings or research repeat.
integration.finance: Billion-dollar MD units. Weekly income/expense aggregates require explicit consumer integration in 00_money_system.txt. Modifier percentages and fixed weekly expenses are separate cumulative burdens. Interest changes are percentage points before native clamps.
integration.buildings: For every building level, first add one shared state slot in the same transaction. Check owner, controller, correct province for province buildings, native building level limit and actual capacity separately. No construction on proposal or preview.
unresolved: PSD incumbent identity and exclusive slot-18 routing require approval and integration.
UCeDe is a post-1982 successor identity within the PCI political tradition; exact identity must be approved, without replacing PD Mendoza.

Native Argentina leader/succession mapping is inconsistent with registry identities: historical pools include slots 2,20,22, while UCR is registry slot3 and PJ slot13. Route all real transitions through reconciled identity checks.
Ongania start expiry is 18 June 1970, while historical removal was 9 June. The concept proposes a real conditional June crisis, not an automatic silent history edit.

Loaded 1970 states already contain nuclear reactors in Cordoba and Pampas despite historical commissioning dates. This concept gives training/construction capability and no free Atucha reactor; baseline correction is a separate review.
All Argentina-specific contract and programme providers remain proposed. No runtime game or multiplayer test has been performed.
integration.uranium: The 1970 startup already registers Los Gigantes in state450: one mine slot, three uranium per level. Raw production and built mines start at zero. Feasibility adds no deposit and never gates native investment; the sponsored mine checks existing construction and capacity before its payment. No automatic raw state-history production.
integration.constitutional: The corporate-charter modifiers operate only while that constitutional settlement remains in force. Actual constitutional restoration removes A Revolution without Consent and deactivates the corporate institutional programme, even if a different party conducts the transition. Earned technical skills and one-time assets retain their separate ownership.
integration.chronology: Precedent dates are research anchors, not automatic unlock dates for every negotiated policy. Earlier bilateral agreements are explicit alternate-history accelerations requiring both players. Named formations and leaders still require real organizational/leadership transitions. Native party trigger ideology names identify engine array slots, while visible Argentine names come from the actual local registry.
integration.timed: Party-sourced event programmes require their exact incumbent party and, for the Menem mandate, exact leader. They deactivate when the owner leaves; a return before fixed expiry restores only the remaining term. National crises and already incurred liabilities follow their separately stated lifetimes. Event option modifiers and an additional attached spirit have separate explicit durations.
